summary: Started India Maps' first weekly-loop test (im-claim-hook: a claim as the first line against the title's question). The other channels' tests are still waiting for data, and there were no owner notes.
why: India Maps makes 2 Shorts a day and had no challenger, so the top first-second entry on its list starts tonight. Geography (geo-claim-hook, day 3) and Craze & Crash (doc-document-first, day 3) each have 0 of 8 Shorts a side with data. How Tech and Disaster Desk make 1 Short a day (owner already told). main's pytest is red on the chogyal photo's missing head cut-out (outside every agent's files; auditor notification pytest-red-chogyal-head), so tonight's change stays in channel data files.
